items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-01-10
items.q: I'm thinking about a guy playing the Egyptian room... Roy Milton, with the Solid Senators. In fact, he just died here about three years ago with Camille Howard and Lily Greenwood, two top female vocalists.

ctx.x: Then, you know, looking at this old newspaper, I'm thinking about a guy playing the Egyptian room, Labor's Union Hall, Sunday night, Roy Milton, with the Solid Senators. In fact, he just died here about three years ago with Camille Howard and Lily Greenwood, two top female vocalists. She was under the promotion of George Moni. Now, George Moni was a, I didn't know him not too well, but George Moni promoted quite a few shows in and around the city of New Orleans. And he was very, well he had a little money, he had…
We went and talked about the Palace Theater. You said that you went to the Palace.
